/* EmployeeMapper.findEmployeeProfileList */ SELECT a.id AS employeeId, a.employee_code, a.employee_role, a.employee_name, b.position_code, b.position_name, d.department_code, d.department_name, c.team_code, c.team_name, e.phone, e.email, a.created_by, f.employee_name AS createdEmployeeName, a.updated_by, g.employee_name AS updatedEmployeeName, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.deleted_at FROM employee.profile a LEFT JOIN employee.position b ON a.position_id = b.id LEFT JOIN employee.team c ON a.team_id = c.id LEFT JOIN employee.department d ON c.department_id = d.id LEFT JOIN auth.account e ON a.id = e.id LEFT JOIN employee.profile f ON a.created_by = f.id LEFT JOIN employee.profile g ON a.updated_by = g.id WHERE a.employee_role != 'LEFT' ORDER BY
b.position_code DESC, a.employee_code DESC, d.department_code DESC, a.created_at DESC
d.department_code DESC, a.employee_code DESC, b.position_code DESC, a.created_at DESC
a.employee_code DESC, b.position_code DESC, d.department_code DESC, a.created_at DESC
b.position_code ASC, a.employee_code ASC, d.department_code ASC, a.created_at ASC
d.department_code ASC, a.employee_code ASC, b.position_code ASC, a.created_at ASC
a.employee_code ASC, b.position_code ASC, d.department_code ASC, a.created_at ASC
OFFSET (#{page} - 1) * #{size} FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

/* EmployeeMapper.findDepartmentList */ SELECT a.id AS departmentId, a.department_code, a.department_name, b.id AS teamId, b.team_code, b.team_name FROM employee.department a LEFT JOIN employee.team b ON a.id = b.department_id ORDER BY a.department_code, b.team_code
/* EmployeeMapper.findPositionList */ SELECT id AS positionId, position_code, position_name, basic_salary, incentive_salary FROM employee.position ORDER BY position_code DESC
/* EmployeeMapper.countEmployeeProfileList */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee.profile WHERE employee_role != 'LEFT'

/* EmployeeMapper.findEmployeeProfileByEmployeeId */ SELECT a.id AS employeeId, a.employee_code, a.employee_role, a.employee_name, b.position_code, b.position_name, d.department_code, d.department_name, c.team_code, c.team_name, e.phone, e.email, a.created_by, f.employee_name AS createdEmployeeName, a.updated_by, g.employee_name AS updatedEmployeeName, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.deleted_at FROM employee.profile a LEFT JOIN employee.position b ON a.position_id = b.id LEFT JOIN employee.team c ON a.team_id = c.id LEFT JOIN employee.department d ON c.department_id = d.id LEFT JOIN auth.account e ON a.id = e.id LEFT JOIN employee.profile f ON a.created_by = f.id LEFT JOIN employee.profile g ON a.updated_by = g.id WHERE a.id = #{employeeId}

/* EmployeeMapper.existsByEmployeeId */ SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM employee.profile a LEFT JOIN employee.position b ON a.position_id = b.id LEFT JOIN employee.team c ON a.team_id = c.id LEFT JOIN employee.department d ON c.department_id = d.id LEFT JOIN auth.account e ON a.id = e.id LEFT JOIN employee.profile f ON a.created_by = f.id LEFT JOIN employee.profile g ON a.updated_by = g.id WHERE a.id = #{employeeId})

/* EmployeeMapper.createEmployeeCode */
WITH seq AS (SELECT NEXTVAL('employee.employee_code_seq') AS value) SELECT 'EMP-' || CASE WHEN value < 1000 THEN LPAD(value::TEXT, 3, '0') ELSE value::TEXT END AS employee_code FROM seq;
SELECT b.team_code FROM employee.profile a JOIN employee.team b ON a.team_id = b.id WHERE a.id = #{employeeId}
mapper.insert: /* EmployeeMapper.createProfile */ INSERT INTO employee.profile (id, employee_code, employee_name, team_id, position_id, employee_role, created_by, updated_by) VALUES ((SELECT id FROM auth.account WHERE user_name = #{employeeCode}), #{employeeCode}, #{employeeName}, (SELECT id FROM employee.team WHERE team_code = #{teamCode}), (SELECT id FROM employee.position WHERE position_code = #{positionCode}), #{employeeRole}::employee.employee_role, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.update: /* EmployeeMapper.updateProfile */ UPDATE employee.profile SET employee_role = #{employeeRole}::employee.employee_role, team_id = (SELECT id FROM employee.team WHERE team_code = #{teamCode}), position_id = (SELECT id FROM employee.position WHERE position_code = #{positionCode}), updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{employeeId}
